The '''City Governor''' was the head of the [[City Council]], the local government of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[D'larah]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. The City Governor was appointed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from a pool of citizens. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the City Governor was [[Jaspar Skeete]].
